title: Dayara Bugyal Trek
reportingPoint: Prince Chowk, Dehradun. Reporting time: 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM on Day 1. Drop at the same point between 6:30 PM and 7:30 PM on Day 4. Please reach Dehradun a day before.
highlights: Trek to the Dayara Bugyal meadows (3,700 m / 12,100 ft)
Two nights of camping at Gui campsite (2,900 m)
Views of Mt Srikanth, Draupadi Ka Danda, Jaonli and Bandarpoonch
Trail through terraced fields and oak and maple forest
All meals, permits, trekking equipment and a certified trek leader
overview:
Dayara Bugyal is an alpine meadow in the Garhwal Himalayas of Uttarakhand, reached by a trail that passes villages, temples and oak forests. This **3 Nights / 4 Days** trek runs from Dehradun to Dehradun: you need to reach Dehradun on your own, ideally a day before, and the group leaves Prince Chowk at 6:30 AM on Day 1.

Day 1 is the 182 km drive to Raithal Village (2,176 m), with a guesthouse stay and a trek briefing. Day 2 is the 4.3 km trek to Gui campsite (2,900 m). Day 3 climbs to the Dayara Bugyal top (3,700 m) and returns to Gui for the night. Day 4 descends to Raithal and drives back to Dehradun by evening. Transfers from Dehradun, camping, all meals, permits, trekking equipment and a trek leader are included. Prices start at ₹6,999 per person (5% GST extra); dual sharing accommodation costs ₹1,000 extra per person.

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Raithal Village (182 km drive)
itinerary.content:
Altitude: 2,176 m / 7,142 ft. Drive time: 8-9 hours.
Leave Prince Chowk, Dehradun at 6:30 AM.
Drive via Suwakholi, Moryana Top and Bhatwari, with views of the Gangotri range, mustard fields and the Bhagirathi River.
Reach Raithal Village in the Uttarkashi region and settle into the guesthouse.
Evening briefing on the trek itinerary, trekking tips and environmental conservation.
Permits and paperwork for the trek are sorted on this day.

itinerary.title: Trek from Raithal to Gui campsite
itinerary.content:
Altitude: 2,900 m / 9,500 ft. Trek duration: 4-5 hours. Trek distance: 4.3 km.
After breakfast, set out on the well-marked trail from Raithal to Gui.
Walk through terraced fields and a forest of oak and maple, with glimpses of Mt Srikanth and Bandarpoonch.
The trail is a steady climb.
Reach Gui campsite, set up tents and have a warm lunch.
Later, explore the nearby Gui Lake at sunset.

itinerary.title: Trek to Dayara Bugyal top and return to Gui
itinerary.content:
Altitude: 3,700 m / 12,100 ft. Trek duration: 8 hours. Trek distance: 4.3 km.
Start after breakfast with a packed lunch.
Climb to the Dayara Bugyal alpine meadows, with views of Bandarpoonch and Black Peak.
Reach Bakaria Top, the summit of this trek, for views of the Gangotri range including Draupadi Ka Danda and Mt Jaonli.
Have lunch at the top, then retrace your steps to Gui campsite.

itinerary.title: Descend to Raithal Village | Drive to Dehradun
itinerary.content:
Trek duration: 3-4 hours. Trek distance: 4.5 km.
After breakfast at Gui, begin the gentle descent to Raithal Village.
Have a hot lunch at Raithal.
Drive back to Dehradun and arrive by evening.
Drop at Prince Chowk between 6:30 PM and 7:30 PM (timings can change with weather and road conditions).

importantNotes:
- This trek runs Dehradun to Dehradun. Please reach Dehradun a day before to avoid any delays.
- Reporting and drop timings can change with weather and road conditions.
- Consult your doctor before joining the trek, and carry your own medicines.
- **Carry a valid government-approved photo ID.** There is no boarding without it.
- **The departure time is fixed.** Keep your phone reachable and update your trip coordinator; they will try calling you, but we can't hold the bus.
- Smoking isn't allowed on the bus.
- The itinerary can change because of weather, road conditions or safety. All sightseeing is subject to weather and local authority guidelines.
- On hill roads the driver may switch off the AC or sound system. Safety comes first.
- Travel insurance isn't included. We recommend buying it before the trip.
- Any increase in entry fees, taxes or fuel costs by the government after booking is charged extra.
- Extra costs from delays outside our control (natural calamity, vehicle breakdown, road closures) are borne by travellers.
- Damage to room or camp furnishings is payable by the guest responsible.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trek start?
faqs.a: The meeting point is Prince Chowk, Dehradun. Reporting time is 6:30 AM to 7:30 AM on Day 1, and the drive to Raithal Village starts at 6:30 AM. The drop on Day 4 is at the same point between 6:30 PM and 7:30 PM. Timings can change with weather and road conditions.

faqs.q: Do I need to reach Dehradun on my own?
faqs.a: Yes. The trek runs Dehradun to Dehradun, so you travel to and from Dehradun yourself. Please reach Dehradun a day before to avoid any delays.

faqs.q: How much does the Dayara Bugyal Trek cost?
faqs.a: ₹6,999 per person. Dual sharing accommodation is ₹1,000 extra per person, which makes it ₹7,999. 5% GST is extra.

Pick-up and drop transfers from Dehradun to Dehradun, camping in dome tents (triple sharing) or alpine tents (quad sharing), all 3 meals plus snacks, trekking and forest permits, campsite fees, trekking equipment, a certified trek leader, a trek crew, safety gear and a trek certificate of completion.

Day 2 is a 4.3 km trek of 4-5 hours from Raithal (2,176 m) to Gui campsite (2,900 m). Day 3 is about 8 hours to the Dayara Bugyal top (3,700 m) and back to Gui. Day 4 is a 4.5 km descent of 3-4 hours to Raithal, followed by the drive to Dehradun.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
